invariants.rationale: Collectors.toMap never returns null, a Map object is always returned.
Each element in data may produce at most one entry in the map; duplicate keys cause merging.
NullList would cause a NullPointerException earlier, so at exit data must be non-null.
parallelism is required and would cause a NullPointerException if null.
func is passed to a wrapper and to map(), so it must be non-null.
